minor.issue: Rate-limiter bucket evasion by phone prefix (CR-089 known gap, severity MINOR). Observed: 5x '9838777712' from distinct IPs → 200,200,200,200,200. 6th call with '+91 9838777712' → 200 (should be 429 if limiter normalised to canonical digits). 7th with '09838777712' → 200 (same evasion). 8th plain '9838777712' → 429 Retry-After=292 (limiter does work when exact format matches). Root cause: scan.py skip_otp_login limiter key is digits-only prefix match — '+91 9838777712' flattens to '919838777712' which lives in a different bucket from '9838777712'. Fix suggestion: run normalize_phone() first, then key the limiter on canonical phone+country_code.

Test uses phone '8888888888' which CR-085-A normalize_phone() now classifies as invalid (status 400 'Enter a valid mobile number'). This cascades to 3 ERROR'd dependent tests (test_p5_skip_otp_existing_password_customer, test_p6_me_with_token, test_p9_scan_profile). NOT a product regression — pre-existing test data needs to be updated to a valid 10-digit number (e.g., 7000000888) by main agent.
